brian.voice_description: A British male TV motorsport commentator in his early sixties, rich warm baritone, fast and excitable when the action peaks, classic broadcast delivery, clean studio recording.
brian.text: Twenty-three hours and fifty-nine minutes. Three thousand miles, and it comes down to one. And the black number four still leads. He held it! How did he hold that?!

declan.voice_description: A man in his late forties, a race engineer on team radio, gruff and tense, low voice, trying to stay calm, slight Northern English accent, clean studio recording.
declan.text: Teo, your rears are gone. Do you copy? Teo. Do you copy? Box this lap if you can hear me. Teo, talk to me.

teo.voice_description: A man of thirty-eight, a world-weary champion racing driver, quiet, low and controlled, slightly husky, understated, neutral English accent, clean studio recording.
teo.text: Declan, I can't see the line. There won't be a seventh. Especially from you. I kept you out so they couldn't do this to you.

isla.voice_description: A woman of twenty-six, a fierce racing driver, strong and emotional, voice cracking with anger and hurt, slight Portuguese accent in English, clean studio recording.
isla.text: Where is he, Declan? You hid it from everyone. Even from me. You beat me half blind! Three years on the bench, and this is why?

leo.voice_description: A male TV reporter in his early thirties, energetic, fast, loud, shouting a question over a crowd, neutral English accent, clean studio recording.
leo.text: Teo! Six wins! Is there a seventh? Teo, over here! The whole paddock wants to know, is this the end?

owner.voice_description: A man in his sixties, wealthy and powerful, smooth, warm on the surface and cold underneath, slow and deliberate, refined English accent, phone-call intimacy, clean studio recording.
owner.text: Hello, Isla. Ready to drive for me? You signed it, Declan. Six months ago. Now get out of the car. I always get what I paid for.

strategist.voice_description: A man in his thirties, a race strategist calling gaps on the radio, clipped and urgent, neutral English accent, clean studio recording.
strategist.text: Ferreira is coming. Point four. Point three. Point two. She's in the window, Declan. Tell him to defend the inside into the chicane.
